name: field-18
description: Date of birth fieldset with label-style legend and three native selects for day, month, and year.

files.content:

Date of birth
Day {Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, i) => ( {i + 1} ))} Month {months.map((m) => ( {m} ))} Year {Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => 2008 - i).map((y) => ( {y} ))}
You must be at least 18 to open a designali.com account.
) }
